The following events took place in '''71 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Grand ChikatLik]]&mdash;the first [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]&mdash;is converted into a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]].<ref name="Cestus Deception" />
*[[Kif]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] of [[Gadon 3]] begin selling high-energy [[Ore/Legends|ores]] on the open market. {{Circa}}<ref name="Cestus Deception" />
